content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

This approach revolves around leveraging sovereign commerce stacks that eliminate reliance on traditional payment platforms. By using tools like NOWPayments, creators can accept cryptocurrency payments seamlessly. Unlike platforms that charge hefty fees, such as Gumroad's 10% on every sale, the 0.5% fee from NOWPayments represents a substantial cost-saving opportunity. This becomes especially significant when considering high sales volumes, allowing creators to retain more revenue and reinvest in their businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure is built on a combination of free and open-source tools that facilitate hosting, payment processing, and product delivery. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, your store can be hosted for free. Backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that automated payment verifications occur without delay. This architecture not only ensures efficiency but also gives you full control over your data and transactions, a key aspect of sovereignty in digital commerce.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions with restricted access to payment platforms. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or templates, this approach allows you to bypass limitations imposed by conventional financial services. By utilizing this infrastructure, creators can focus on their craft without the constant worry of payment failures or high transaction fees that eat into profits. It levels the playing field for creators across the globe, ensuring equitable access to a global digital marketplace.
Retain more of your earnings with low transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful deployment involves several interrelated components. The hosting service, be it GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, provides the storefront. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, allowing for multiple cryptocurrencies without the burden of KYC regulations. For product delivery, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that digital goods are delivered automatically once a payment is confirmed. Each component is designed to integrate seamlessly, creating a cohesive system that operates independently of traditional platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by assessing your digital products and the markets you want to reach. Next, select the appropriate infrastructure stack based on your needs—either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Follow the deployment documentation to set up your store, integrate payment processing, and configure product delivery. Finally, launch your store and begin marketing your Notion templates to potential customers. This streamlined process empowers you to take immediate action and start generating revenue.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Deploy your digital store without relying on traditional platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to optimize your digital product sales, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for deploying your own sovereign stack. Explore options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for comprehensive solutions to your digital commerce needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook by setting up a sovereign commerce stack that accepts cryptocurrency payments. Use NOWPayments for processing and automate delivery with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
The ideal approach is to utilize a combination of free tools and NOWPayments for low-cost payment processing. This setup minimizes fees and retains more profit from each sale.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By deploying your own online store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers while handling payments through NOWPayments.
What kind of fees can I expect with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a nominal fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than the 10% fee that platforms like Gumroad impose. This fee structure allows for better revenue retention.
Do I need technical skills to set up this system?
While some technical knowledge is beneficial, the provided documentation and templates in the Complete Builder Kit simplify the setup process, making it accessible for most creators.
